newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dozens injured in Thai hotel fire, some trapped.
newsitem.headline: Dozens injured in Thai hotel fire, some trapped.

text.p: At least 32 people, including foreign tourists, were injured and several were trapped by a fire in a hotel at Thailand's beach resort town of Pattaya, police and hospital sources said on Friday.

Firefighters told Reuters by telephone the fire began in the ground floor coffee house of the Royal Jomtien resort and spread to the sixth floor of the 16-storey building at the resort, about 200 km (120 miles) southeast of Bangkok.
Several people were trapped on the top floor of the hotel building and firefighters asked for relief helicopters to help in rescue efforts.
Two of the 32 injured were rushed to a nearby hospital with serious burns, hospital sources said.
